objective.name: runtime_data
objective.description: Defines the content (substance) of a runtime Matter: execution status, active cognitive run, current mailbox message and active wait groups of one continuity.

functional._continuity_id_note: Required. Identifier of the unique continuity owning this runtime.
functional._status_note: Required. Current operational state of the continuity.
functional._run_id_note: Present while status is running or waiting. Identifies the unique logical cognitive run currently owning the continuity. Null or absent while idle or suspended.
functional._current_message_id_note: Optional. Identifier of the mailbox message currently being processed across the whole cognitive chain, including waits and resumptions.
functional._active_wait_groups_note: Required. Collection of wait groups currently belonging to the active cognitive run. A group remains present through waiting and satisfied states until its cognitive resume is completed.
